secondsToTopSpeed.label: time to reach top speed from a stand, flat out

stoppingDistance.label: stopping distance from full speed, brake held

coastingDistance.label: how far the shunter rolls from full speed when you let go of everything

kickedWagonRun.label: how far a wagon runs on its own after being kicked off at 36 km/h

gentleCouplingLimit.label: fastest you can buffer up and still get "coupled up", not "a thump"

couplingReach.label: how close the buffers must get before they hook on
